title: Matthew Brown's WMD corruption whistleblowing

tellings.quote: There's a lot of things corruption things to do with um WMDs that was his specialty that that he also whistle blew on

plain: Matthew Brown, a State Department official whose specialty was weapons of mass destruction, blew the whistle on corruption tied to those weapons, on top of his better-known UFO claims. Jeremy Corbell, a UFO filmmaker and researcher, says this on the show, describing it as one of several things Brown reported. He brings it up to show that Brown had raised serious alarms before.
